fullContentHtml:
Madras High Court Assistant Programmer Result 2026 - Check Candidate Scores at mhc.tn.gov.in - Complete Details

The Madras High Court has released the Assistant Programmer Result 2026. Candidates who appeared for the Assistant Programmer examination can check and download their result online through the official Madras High Court website. The result contains the list of candidates shortlisted for the next stage of the selection process.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 10.08.2025
  • Exam Conducted On : 06.09.2026 (Sunday)
  • Total candidates listed (registration numbers) : 2,222
  • Candidates marked "Present" (scored marks in Part-A and Part-B) : 1,065
  • Candidates marked "Absent" : 1,157

Application Fee

  • Post Name : Assistant Programmer
  • Result / Marks List Issued On : 17.09.2026
  • Total candidates listed (registration numbers) : 2,222
  • Candidates marked "Present" (scored marks in Part-A and Part-B) : 1,065
  • Highest Part-A score recorded : 46
  • Highest Part-B score recorded : 62.5
  • Highest combined (Part-A + Part-B) score : 101.5 (Registration No. 251710786)

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
